# scanner-line-ending-import

normalizeLines(text) converts each CRLF pair to one LF and each remaining lone CR to one LF. Existing LF characters and all other text stay unchanged. Empty input stays empty.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Keep the public API and tests/ unchanged. Use Node built-ins only; no packages or network.
